title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
description: Given a binary tree represented as a list (None for missing nodes), return the inorder traversal.
solution:
def inorder(tree):
    if not tree: return []
    result = []
    def dfs(i):
        if i >= len(tree) or tree[i] is None: return
        dfs(2*i+1)
        result.append(tree[i])
        dfs(2*i+2)
    dfs(0)
    return result

title: Same Tree
description: Given two binary trees represented as lists, check if they are identical.
solution:
def is_same_tree(p, q):
    if not p and not q: return True
    if not p or not q: return False
    if p[0] != q[0]: return False
    def same(i, j):
        li = 2*i+1 if i < len(p) else i
        ri = 2*i+2 if i < len(p) else i
        lj = 2*j+1 if j < len(q) else j
        rj = 2*j+2 if j < len(q) else j
        lv = p[li] if li < len(p) and p[li] is not None else None
        rv = p[ri] if ri < len(p) and p[ri] is not None else None
        ljv = q[lj] if lj < len(q) and q[lj] is not None else None
        rjv = q[rj] if rj < len(q) and q[rj] is not None else None
        if lv != ljv or rv != rjv: return False
        return True
    return same(0, 0)

title: Level Order Traversal
description: Given a binary tree represented as a list, return the level order traversal as a list of lists.
solution:
def level_order(tree):
    if not tree: return []
    from collections import deque
    result = []
    queue = deque([(0, 0)])
    while queue:
        i, level = queue.popleft()
        if i >= len(tree) or tree[i] is None: continue
        if len(result) <= level:
            result.append([])
        result[level].append(tree[i])
        queue.append((2*i+1, level+1))
        queue.append((2*i+2, level+1))
    return result

title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Given a binary tree represented as a list, invert it (swap left and right children at every level) and return the inverted tree as a list.
solution:
def invert_tree(tree):
    if not tree: return []
    result = list(tree)
    def invert(i):
        if i >= len(result) or result[i] is None: return
        li, ri = 2*i+1, 2*i+2
        if li < len(result) and ri < len(result):
            result[li], result[ri] = result[ri], result[li]
        invert(li)
        invert(ri)
    invert(0)
    return result
